content_svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 780 480" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="background:#fff;font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="6" refY="3" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0,0 L0,6 L8,3 z" fill="#0B64DD"/>
    </marker>
    <pattern id="hatch" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="6" height="6" patternTransform="rotate(45)">
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="6" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>

  <!-- Title -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="780" height="46" fill="#0B64DD"/>
  <text x="390" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="white">Three-Phase Induction Motor — Cross Section Diagram (IEC 60034)</text>

  <!-- Motor body outline -->
  <rect x="80" y="80" width="520" height="280" rx="12" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#101C3F" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- Stator windings -->
  <ellipse cx="340" cy="220" rx="200" ry="100" fill="none" stroke="#48EFCF" stroke-width="8" stroke-dasharray="18,6"/>
  <text x="340" y="145" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#0B64DD" font-weight="bold">STATOR WINDING</text>
  <text x="340" y="158" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#555">3-phase, 50Hz, 400V</text>

  <!-- Rotor -->
  <ellipse cx="340" cy="220" rx="110" ry="60" fill="#E8F0FE" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="340" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#0B64DD" font-weight="bold">ROTOR</text>
  <text x="340" y="240" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#555">Squirrel-cage, 1450 RPM</text>

  <!-- Shaft -->
  <rect x="70" y="212" width="560" height="16" rx="8" fill="#343741" stroke="#1C1E23" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="680" y="225" font-size="10" fill="#333" font-weight="bold">SHAFT</text>

  <!-- Drive-End Bearing (DE) — monitoring point -->
  <circle cx="120" cy="220" r="28" fill="#FEC514" stroke="#101C3F" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text x="120" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#1C1E23">DE</text>
  <text x="120" y="228" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#1C1E23">BEARING</text>
  <line x1="120" y1="192" x2="120" y2="80" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,3" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <rect x="65" y="52" width="110" height="30" rx="4" fill="#E8F0FE" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="120" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#0B64DD" font-weight="bold">⚡ Sensor DE</text>
  <text x="120" y="78" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">Vibration + Temp</text>

  <!-- Non-Drive End Bearing (NDE) -->
  <circle cx="560" cy="220" r="28" fill="#FEC514" stroke="#101C3F" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text x="560" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#1C1E23">NDE</text>
  <text x="560" y="228" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#1C1E23">BEARING</text>
  <line x1="560" y1="192" x2="560" y2="80" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,3" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <rect x="505" y="52" width="110" height="30" rx="4" fill="#E8F0FE" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="560" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#0B64DD" font-weight="bold">⚡ Sensor NDE</text>
  <text x="560" y="78" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">Vibration + Temp</text>

  <!-- Thermal sensor on winding -->
  <circle cx="255" cy="165" r="10" fill="#FF957D" stroke="#101C3F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="255" y="169" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" font-weight="bold" fill="white">T</text>
  <line x1="255" y1="155" x2="210" y2="80" stroke="#FF957D" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3,3" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <rect x="155" y="52" width="110" height="30" rx="4" fill="#FFF0EB" stroke="#FF957D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="210" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#FF957D" font-weight="bold">🌡 Winding Temp</text>
  <text x="210" y="78" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="#555">RTD PT100, ±0.5°C</text>

  <!-- Current sensor -->
  <rect x="95" y="340" width="490" height="34" rx="4" fill="#E8F0FE" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="340" y="355" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#0B64DD" font-weight="bold">⚡ Current Draw Monitoring</text>
  <text x="340" y="368" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#555">Hall-effect CT on Phase L1 · Range: 0–25A · Sample rate: 1kHz · Streamed to apex_operational_telemetry</text>

  <!-- Failure threshold annotations -->
  <rect x="80" y="395" width="520" height="70" rx="6" fill="#FFF8E1" stroke="#FEC514" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="340" y="413" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#1C1E23">⚠  Action Thresholds (per ISO 10816-3)</text>
  <text x="100" y="430" font-size="9" fill="#343741">• Vibration DE/NDE: Alert ≥4.5 mm/s RMS | Block ≥7.1 mm/s RMS</text>
  <text x="100" y="445" font-size="9" fill="#343741">• Winding Temperature: Alert ≥85°C | Emergency shutdown ≥105°C</text>
  <text x="100" y="460" font-size="9" fill="#343741">• Current draw: Alert ≥20A (≈133% FLC) | Fault ≥22A — correlates with bearing deterioration or rotor eccentricity</text>

  <!-- Legend -->
  <rect x="605" y="130" width="155" height="100" rx="6" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="682" y="148" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#1C1E23">LEGEND</text>
  <circle cx="622" cy="165" r="7" fill="#FEC514" stroke="#101C3F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="635" y="169" font-size="9" fill="#333">Bearing (rolling element)</text>
  <circle cx="622" cy="185" r="7" fill="#FF957D" stroke="#101C3F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="635" y="189" font-size="9" fill="#333">Thermal sensor (RTD)</text>
  <line x1="615" y1="205" x2="632" y2="205" stroke="#48EFCF" stroke-width="4"/>
  <text x="635" y="209" font-size="9" fill="#333">Stator winding</text>
  <line x1="615" y1="218" x2="632" y2="218" stroke="#0B64DD" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>
  <text x="635" y="222" font-size="9" fill="#333">Sensor lead</text>
</svg>
description_text: Detailed cross-section diagram of a three-phase induction motor (IEC 60034) showing: drive-end bearing (DE) and non-drive end bearing (NDE) with vibration and temperature sensor placement; stator winding with RTD PT100 thermal sensor; current draw monitoring via Hall-effect CT on phase L1. Action thresholds per ISO 10816-3: vibration alert at 4.5 mm/s RMS, emergency at 7.1 mm/s; winding temperature alert at 85°C, shutdown at 105°C; current fault above 22A correlates with bearing deterioration or rotor eccentricity.
